title: Drop skill_source = "plugin" and restore a repo-local lore skill: the plugin is disabled in this checkout, so no lore skill exists at runtime (DEC-238 a1)
description:
Ruling DEC-238 (a1) from opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = \"plugin\" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = \"plugin\" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

MEASURED in this checkout on 2026-10-25, before acting:
- `git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml` line 29 sets `skill_source = "plugin"` (under [agents]).
- `.claude/settings.local.json` (gitignored) sets `opum-lore@opum=false`, i.e. the plugin is disabled for this checkout.
- `.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` does not exist.
- `lore agents --check` (lore 0.14.1) prints `absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` and `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user`, and exits 0.
Net: the repository names the plugin as its skill source while the plugin is off here, so the lore skill is absent at runtime.

This is a tier-2 decision about this repository own governing files: the edit is the owning session decision, or its user, not an instruction relayed from the orchestrator. It is NOT scheduled yet; start nothing until the plan schedules it. The per-checkout plugin setting in settings.local.json is explicitly untouched by this action.

Context: QCLI-237 (Done) opted this repo into skill_source = "plugin" in 2026-09-05, when the plugin was enabled here. This task reverses that declaration for as long as the plugin stays off in this checkout, and re-establishing it later is a separate measured step.

acceptanceCriteria.text: git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml no longer sets skill_source = "plugin": the [agents] table omits the key, or the table is removed
After the change, `lore agents --check` no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced (where it did before) and reports the Claude skill file up-to-date
.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists as a repo-local generated file and is committed on dev
`lore agents --check` and `lore check` both exit 0, measured at the repository CI-pinned lore version and cited beside criteria 2 and 3, never alone

The `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user` line is EXPECTED to remain while the override stands and is not a failure; it reports the 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting that (a1) leaves untouched
.claude/settings.local.json is unchanged: the per-checkout plugin setting stays exactly as it is, whatever its reason

CLAUDE.md carries no sentence asserting the lore skill comes from the plugin: a managed-block sentence is corrected by regenerating lore:agents, and if regeneration still writes the plugin wording that is filed as a lore-cli template defect rather than hand-edited

definitionOfDone.text: The change is config and documentation only: no product source, tests or packaging are touched
The landing PR records the measured before/after evidence and the DEC-238 (a1) and (a3) citations
The record states that returning to skill_source = "plugin" requires the plugin to be measured enabled in this checkout first

implementationNotes:
DEC-238 (a2), opum-doc ruling 2026-10-25T06:54:02Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a2), applied to the criteria above.

(1) The original criterion — lore agents --check exits 0 — proved nothing, because it already passes broken. The criterion set now requires the two diagnostic lines to disappear and .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md to exist, with both exit codes cited beside them.

BEFORE-STATE, measured in this checkout on 2026-10-25, to be proved both ways by re-running each line after the change:
  git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml, line 29  ->  skill_source = "plugin"
  .claude/settings.local.json                     ->  opum-lore@opum=false
  ls .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md                 ->  No such file or directory
  lore agents --check (lore 0.14.1)               ->  exit 0, output verbatim:
      absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md
      up-to-date CLAUDE.md
      plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user
      plugin-claude-remedy claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user

(2) On the hand-written-sentence clause: this repository has no hand-written sentence saying a .claude/skills/ copy is drift. The only close candidate is CLAUDE.md line 59, and it sits INSIDE the lore:agents managed block, so lore agents generates it rather than a person writing it. The expectation is that regeneration rewrites that line once skill_source stops being plugin; if it still says the skill comes from the plugin after regeneration, that is a lore-cli template finding to report, not a line to hand-edit. The quest-side sentence at CLAUDE.md lines 46-48 sits inside the Quest managed block and is out of scope under (a3), which leaves opum-quest alone.

DEC-238 (a3), opum-doc ruling 2026-10-25T07:18:35Z (record: opum-ai/opum-doc#1354, merged), RULED A. Verbatim: "(a2)(1) was unsatisfiable. The plugin-claude disabled ... scope=user line reports the 2026-10-20 override itself, which (a1) leaves untouched, so it stays after a correct fix." The criterion now reads: after the change, lore agents --check no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced (where it did before) and reports the Claude skill file up-to-date; .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists; lore agents --check and lore check both exit 0. The plugin-claude disabled line is EXPECTED to remain while the override stands and is not a failure.

SEQUENCING, applied: lore check is measured at this repository CI-pinned lore version, as CI runs it. Measured 2026-10-25: local lore --version = 0.14.1 and .github/workflows/lore-check.yml line 198 pins @opum-ai/lore@0.14.1, so local and CI agree and no newer-binary substitution applies. There is no open lore version-drift task in this repository, so the (a1) task measures at the pinned version and says so here.

BEFORE-STATE RE-MEASURED at the pinned version, 2026-10-25T07:19Z:
  lore --version                                  ->  0.14.1   (CI pin: 0.14.1)
  lore agents --check                             ->  exit 0
      absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md
      up-to-date CLAUDE.md
      plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user
      plugin-claude-remedy claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user
  ls .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md                 ->  No such file or directory
  lore check                                      ->  exit 0
      Agent profiles: 4 read, 0 over capacity
      65 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 5 out-of-bundle links skipped
  git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml, line 29  ->  skill_source = "plugin"
  .claude/settings.local.json                     ->  opum-lore@opum=false

Point 2 of DEC-238 (a4) also confirmed: (a2)(2) covers HAND-WRITTEN prose only; a managed-block sentence is corrected by regenerating the block. This repository has none, so nothing is owed under (a2)(2) beyond the regeneration check already recorded in the criterion.

IMPLEMENTED on branch chore/QCLI-530-dec238-lore-skill, 2026-10-25T08:03Z. Change: removed the [agents] table (skill_source = "plugin") from .lore/config.toml, then ran `lore agents` (lore 0.14.1, the CI pin at .github/workflows/lore-check.yml:198) with skill_source at its default "repo". It created .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md (6862 bytes) and rewrote the managed lore:agents block in CLAUDE.md from "installed from the `opum-lore` Claude Code plugin, not this repository" to "`.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` — how to drive lore." That regeneration is the managed-block correction Point 2 of DEC-238 (a4) describes; no hand edit was made to it.

AFTER-STATE, measured at 08:03Z:
  lore agents --check   -> exit 0
      up-to-date .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md
      up-to-date CLAUDE.md
      plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user        <- EXPECTED to remain (a3)
      plugin-claude-remedy claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user
  lore check            -> exit 0
      Agent profiles: 4 read, 0 over capacity
      65 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 5 out-of-bundle links skipped
  ls .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md  ->  present, 6862 bytes
  quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude -> exit 0, state: current (Quest block untouched)
  .claude/settings.local.json -> still ignored (.gitignore:3), not written by this change

PROVED BOTH WAYS against the before-state recorded above: the absent-plugin-sourced line and the missing file are gone in the same checkout, at the same lore version, with the only inputs changed being .lore/config.toml and the files lore regenerated.
finalSummary: Dropped the [agents] skill_source = "plugin" declaration from .lore/config.toml and regenerated the lore bridge with `lore agents` at the CI-pinned lore 0.14.1: it created the repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and rewrote the managed lore:agents sentence in CLAUDE.md to point at that file instead of the plugin. Proved both ways at the same version: before, `lore agents --check` exited 0 while printing absent-plugin-sourced and the skill file was missing; after, it prints up-to-date for both the skill file and CLAUDE.md, the absent-plugin-sourced line is gone, and `lore check` is 0 errors, 0 warnings over 65 files. The `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user` line remains by design (DEC-238 (a3) RULED A) because it reports the per-checkout override that (a1) keeps; .claude/settings.local.json was not touched. No product source, tests or packaging changed.
